implementation.marker: rp1/<requested uint32 frame token>/<capture UUID>; actual Viz token must match. A later token emits a per-ID zero-pass supersession receipt. Raw legacy IDs remain explicitly unversioned.
implementation.retry: Only VIZ_CAPTURE_SUPERSEDED is retried, with a fresh ID and complete resources after draining the original native/CDP callback. Transport/encoding errors and navigation invalidation retain their normal failure paths.
implementation.demand: Detaching the last display drains the outstanding native callback with BeginFrame alive before stopping the clock; it does not register another attempt.
